name: Binay Laha

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Binay Laha’s literary work includes poetry and the editing of Indology, an English little magazine associated with Raiganj in West Bengal. His Setu contributor biography names Auction of My Soul, The Wife of Red Soil and Bad Boy Good Girl among his books. He also co-edited Voices Now: World Poetry Today with Braja K. Sorkar, bringing together an international selection of poetry.

In “My love,” his Kabita Live contribution, companionship becomes a source of balance and possibility. The brief stanzas move from a shared smile to the image of a canvas on which a life can be painted, while leaving the beloved’s mystery intact.
